title: synesis/getExcerpts — response
description: ITEM blocks of one bibref, plus the fields of its SOURCE block. Producer: get_excerpts (explorer_requests.py). Consumers: DataService.getExcerpts and DataService.getExcerptsWithSource (dataService.js). The `source` key was added after the endpoint shipped: an older server omits it, and the client treats its absence as 'no SOURCE fields'.

extra_fields.description: Field name -> JSON-safe value. Includes fields the transformer promotes off extra_fields (quote/note), reinserted by _reinsert_promoted_fields.

line.description: 1-based, as received from the compiler. DataService converts to 0-based.

source.description: Fields of the SOURCE block for this bibref, name -> JSON-safe value. Empty object when the SOURCE has no extra fields or the bibref is unknown — never null.
